turns.message: In general, if an operating system is not recorded for a game, is that proof the game cannot run on it today?

response.message: No. The catalog only records operating‑system support that was explicitly noted at the time of the data capture. If an OS isn’t listed, it simply means the catalog didn’t have a verified record for that platform—not that the game is impossible to run on it today. Compatibility can change over time (updates, community patches, new releases, etc.), and many games that lack a recorded entry for a particular OS may still work on it. Always check the latest source (e.g., the game’s store page, developer notes, or community reports) for the current status.
